# Persuasion/information synthetic fixture

`synthetic-contrast-ledger.json` is self-authored fictional aggregate metadata for offline validator tests. The DOI, URLs, dates and numbers are invented; no participant, demographic, belief, transcript, stimulus, generated message or source-file rows are present. The fixture makes no factual research claim and is not a reconstruction of a dataset. It is original repository test material under the repository software license, not a relicense of third-party data.

The factual ledger under `data/evidence-program/research/` is a separately hand-curated, limited record of published quantitative facts and source links. It does not contain a copied CSV, workbook, PDF, code, source excerpt or dialogue. The third-party dataset and article licenses remain separately recorded in the catalog. Those rights are not changed by this fixture or the repository's data dedication.

Tests validate shape, comparison identity, units, uncertainty association, version provenance and the correction edge. They do not reproduce the ordinal model, verify raw research data or prove population-level influence. The in-memory checker performs no network access, file acquisition, code execution, statistical fitting or model inference. The original participant-CSV adapter proposal is not implemented.
